verdict.rationale: Customer.io's core product is automations: workflows triggered by events or segment membership that run on their own with goals, exit criteria and waits. An AI assistant can create and manage these automations through the official MCP server and CLI. The built-in agent also supports recurring scheduled tasks (Daily Routines) that run automatically, and a community user confirms building strong workflows. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that AI-built automations and scheduled agent routines work as claimed.
